description.zh: 创建白板应用时用户在控制台设置的应用名称，由1~32位的中文、英文、数字或下划线组成。
description.en: The application name that you set in the console when creating a whiteboard application. The name must be 1 to 32 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, and underscores.

descriptions.zh:
# 使用说明

- 本接口用于创建白板应用。
- 目前互动白板控制台还未正式上线，请通过互动白板服务端SDK进行白板应用的相关操作。

# QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~342798~~)。
descriptions.en:
# Operation description

- This operation is used to create a whiteboard application.
- The interactive whiteboard console is not yet officially online. Use the interactive whiteboard server SDK to perform related operations on whiteboard applications.

# QPS limit
The single-user QPS limit for this operation is 100 calls per second. If the limit is exceeded, the API invocation is throttled, which may affect your business. Invoke this operation properly. For more information, see [QPS limit](~~342798~~).
